p: בַּמִּדְרָשׁ רַבָּה (אֱמוֹר, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה כט, ז)
"In the seventh month, on the first of the month":
who had a case before his father.
'If you wish to be acquitted before me
כָּךְ אָמַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְיִשְׂרָאֵל:
So said the Holy One, blessed be He, to Yisrael:
'invoke the merit of the Avos,' etc.
שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (יְחֶזְקֵאל לג, כד) אֶחָד הָיָה אַבְרָהָם;
'a remembrance of teruah' — this is Yitzchak,
שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (בְּרֵאשִׁית כב, יג) וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה אַיִל;
as it says (Bereishis 22:13), 'And he saw, and behold, a ram';
'a holy convocation' — this is Yaakov," etc.
to plead for the accused with arguments
and to show that he is innocent in judgment.
by invoking the merit of the Avos,
זֶה הוּא לִימּוּד זְכוּת עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל,
there is a plea of merit for Yisrael,
that in them too is found
the holiness of the three Avos.
for he stood alone in the world
in publicizing the glory of His kingship, blessed be His Name,
and paid no heed to the whole world,
though the whole world was against him;
and even when they cast him into the fiery furnace,
he did not budge from his faith.
And this becomes clearer still in exile;
a nation and a kingdom of their own,
וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן בְּאוֹרֶךְ הַגָּלוּת
and nevertheless, through the long exile,
"we have not forgotten the name of our G-d,"
and they stand out as "one nation in the land" —
like Avraham, who was one in the world.
that passed over us in exile,
in the generations of forced conversion,
וְעִם כָּל זֹאת מָסְרוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל נַפְשָׁם
and despite it all Yisrael gave their lives
זֶהוּ כְּמוֹ אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
this is like Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
whom they cast into the fiery furnace,
and he did not turn from his way.
in which we acknowledge the power of His kingship,
like Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who made known and publicized His kingship,
so that He was called "G-d of the earth"
the Holy One, blessed be He, 'Master'
corresponds to the attribute of Malchus
And it says, "'A remembrance of teruah' — this is Yitzchak,
as it says, 'And he saw, and behold, a ram.'"
וְהוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה לו, ה)
This is based on what they said (Vayikra Rabbah 36:5):
"Why is 'remembrance' said of Yaakov and Avraham,
but not said of Yitzchak?" etc.:
as though heaped upon the altar."
It is like what is said
בְּשֵׁם הַבַּעַל שֵׁם טוֹב זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
in the name of the Baal Shem Tov, of blessed memory,
עַל הַפָּסוּק (תְּהִלִּים קכא, ה) ה' צִלֶּךָ:
on the pasuk (Tehillim 121:5), "Hashem is your shadow":
that He is like a shadow —
so Hashem Yisbarach conducts Himself with him.
that there always stands before him
knowing that he stands before the King.
And just as the fear of Hashem Yisbarach
And this is "a remembrance of teruah":
to arouse fear and dread in the heart,
"If a shofar is blown in a city,
And the merit of Yitzchak is aroused
that in them too are found fear and dread,
מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם.
the attribute of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him.
and through this "your remembrance will rise
And it says, "'A holy convocation' — this is Yaakov,
'Listen to Me, Yaakov, and Yisrael, My called one.'"
and "You are holy" corresponds to Yaakov,
"And they will sanctify the Holy One of Yaakov"
that holiness is found in Yisrael too;
and "You shall be holy to Me" (Vayikra 20:26);
וְהוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה טו, כד)
It is based on what they said (Shemos Rabbah 15:24):
when filled from the holy, becomes sanctified,
who are holy and sanctify the month."
Because there is holiness in Yisrael,
עַל יְדֵי זֶה יֵשׁ לָהֶם כֹּחַ
to bring holiness into the festivals.
And this is "'A holy convocation' — this is Yaakov":
that from Yaakov comes the plea of merit
that holiness is found in Yisrael
and they can bring holiness into the festivals.
דְּאַף דְּשׁוֹפָר הוּא מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל יִצְחָק,
for although the shofar is Yitzchak's attribute,
nevertheless it is stated in the Tikkunim
that teruah is from the side of Yaakov,
"And the teruah of the King is in him";
that is, he expounds that it refers
to the beginning of the pasuk:
"He has not beheld iniquity in Yaakov,
nor seen perversity in Yisrael," etc.,
"and the teruah of the King is in him" —
That is, the teruah comes from Yaakov's side,
for he was like Adam HaRishon
And the tekios serve to arouse
and the entire first blemish be repaired.
in Midrash Rabbah in what is said,
who fulfill the mitzvah of shofar,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִהְיֶה זְכוּת עֲלֵיהֶם
and through this there will be merit for them,
the attribute of the Fear of Yitzchak.
and will bring holiness into the festivals,
וְזֶה עַל יְדֵי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהֶם קְדוּשָּׁה.
and this is through there being holiness in them.
That is, because they have in them
of the holiness of Yaakov Avinu,
who is the root of holiness,
"And they will sanctify the Holy One of Yaakov";
and this is an invocation of merit for Yisrael,
that they are crowned with the Avos.
surely this refers to the time,
so how is there alluded in it
the invocation of the merit of Avraham,
But the matter is along the lines of
שֶׁדִּקְדְּקוּ בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה ג, ח)
what they inferred in Midrash Rabbah (Bereishis Rabbah 3:8)
from what is said at the creation of the world,
and they expounded on it: "one day" —
שֶׁהָיָה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא יָחִיד בְּעוֹלָמוֹ.
when the Holy One, blessed be He, was alone in His world.
from what is said, "on the one of the month,"
that it ought to have said
"on the first of the month" or "on Rosh Chodesh."
Moreover, the whole phrase is superfluous:
since it is written, "in the seventh chodesh,"
in the manner of what it says (Yeshayahu 66:23),
"from one new moon to the next,"
"and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened,"
so why did it need to say "on the one"?
"What is 'one'? The choicest of its flock."
So too it is expounded here:
"on the first of the month" — from the special day.
And what is the special day?
It is "the day of the world's conception";
and then is the time when man will be rectified,
that he be according to the thought
And just as they expounded in the Work of Creation,
יוֹם אֶחָד — שֶׁהָיָה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
"one day" — that the Holy One, blessed be He, was
so here "on the first of the month" is expounded
that then is the time that man will recognize
the oneness of Hashem — that Havayah is One.
And this alludes to the holiness
of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him.
וְהוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאִיתָא (פְּסָחִים נו, א)
It is based on what is stated (Pesachim 56a),
that the tribes said to Yaakov Avinu:
"Just as in your heart there is only One,
so in our heart there is only One."
That is, Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
recognized through the attribute of truth,
just as before the world was created —
which is what the Name Havayah denotes:
He was, He is, and He will be.
But this Name is not pronounced
"So in our heart there is only One":
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
This is along the lines of what is said (Zohar III 230a):
"He is truth, and She is faith."
through the holiness of Avraham Avinu,
who was the first to merit this.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנִּדְרָשׁ (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה ד, ח, ג)
תָּשׁוּרִי מֵרֹאשׁ אֲמָנָה (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ד, ח)
"'Look from the peak of Amanah' (Shir HaShirim 4:8) —
as it says (Bereishis 15:6), 'And he believed in Hashem.'"
"And Avraham was old, advanced in days" —
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קכט, א),
as it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 129a) —
that he merited the attribute of zakein.
to call the Holy One, blessed be He, "Master,"
וְכֵן כָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א ריט, א):
And so it is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 219a):
וַה' בֵּרַךְ אֶת אַבְרָהָם בַּכֹּל (בְּרֵאשִׁית כד, א):
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכָה לְמִדַּת זָקֵן,
And through this he merited the attribute of zakein,
as before the world was created.
And that is why he is called "the peak of Amanah."
And this is what Midrash Rabbah expounds,
what is said, "on the first of the month,"
alludes that this day is the special day
on which Yisrael merit to attain,
through the attribute of faith, the oneness —
וְזֶה עַל יְדֵי שֶׁהֵם מִתְעַטְּרָא בַּאֲבָהָן,
And this is because they are crowned with the Avos —
with the holiness of Avraham Avinu,
of whom it is written, "Avraham was one."
with the holiness of the three Avos,
they will be advocates for Yisrael,
that they be acquitted in judgment, as stated.
